page.overview:
Who is Jerry?

Jerry was a U.S. Army soldier who was killed during a raid on his base by members of the Lizard League.

Nothing is known about Jerry except that he was a soldier posted at an Army base in Wyoming.

He was seen grabbing a snack from a vending machine because he missed lunch during a shift. His superior found him, initially thinking he was an enemy, before they were both soon killed by Iguana. Jerry's throat was sliced open by Iguana's talons.
